page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a high clock speed compute instance built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor offering 20 physical cores and 40 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. The processor architecture includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates vector and cryptographic instruction sets including AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES.

System memory consists of 192.0 GB of RAM, providing an allocation ratio of 4.8 GB per vCPU. Benchmark measurements place read-only memory bandwidth at 108.89 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 48.09 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside cached small-block bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec. The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage volumes for persistent data, and features no dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results for the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge consistently sit within middle-tier industry distributions. Multi-core performance reaches 38378.07 in stress-ng and 12045.0 in Geekbench multi-core testing, with single-core Geekbench registering at 1289.0. Application throughput tests demonstrate 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 25.35 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. For CPU-based language model tasks, the instance achieves 1841.39 prompt tokens per second on small 135M models and 56.94 tokens per second on medium 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency standpoint, the server provides balanced compute capacity and high clock speeds without the expense of specialized hardware accelerators. Workloads that benefit from this configuration include compilation pipelines, enterprise web serving, distributed caching nodes, relational databases utilizing cloud storage, and intermediate analytical processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server configured with 40 dedicated vCPUs and 20 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed by KVM, the system includes 192.0 GB of memory, equating to 4.8 GB per vCPU, and a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. It features no local NVMe storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage for disk operations. Standardized benchmark evaluations position its CPU and memory throughput within the median tier, demonstrated by 38378.07 multi-core stress-ng points, 12045.0 multi-core Geekbench marks, and 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second. The instance is suited for multi-threaded build environments, high-concurrency web tiers, relational databases, and enterprise backends.
